root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward separation into detached portions: a detached small group, a piece of a thing, or things reduced to torn fragments.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence connects the Quranic people-group noun with being cut off or separated, while Classical usage extends the same imagery to individual portions and much-torn garments.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun has a distinct lexical identity and is presented under its normalized citation form.

senses.definition: A detached small group or band of people.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage denotes a people-group characterized as separated or detached and few.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or portion of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recorded plural forms are شَرَاذِمُ and شَرَاذِيمُ; the usage includes a portion of such things as a quince.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old, worn-out, and much-torn, said of a garment or garments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional plural expression, as in ثَوْبٌ شَرَاذِمُ or ثِيَابٌ شَرَاذِمُ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The Quran-attested people-group meaning is represented.

cautions: Lane records a variant شِرْدِمَةٌ with unpointed د; it is not treated as a separate Quranic form.
